''"''Tell them we wish to board at once.|Qui-Gon Jinn and Maoi Madakor before boarding the ''Saak'ak''||audio=MadakorAndJinn.flac}} The '''''Saak'ak''''' was a modified [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] that was part of the private [[Trade Federation fleet|fleet]] of the [[Trade Federation]] and served as the Federation's [[flagship]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo]]. [[Commanding officer|Commanded]] by [[Captain]] [[Daultay Dofine]], the [[freighter]] was visited by [[Galactic Republic]] [[ambassador]]s, [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his Padawan, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who were sent to negotiate with the Federation [[Viceroy]], [[Nute Gunray]], about ceasing their [[blockade]] to resume trade with the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. However, the negotiations did not work and the [[Jedi]] were forced to escape to the planet's surface.{{SWE|characters|daultaydofine|Daultay Dofine}} ==History== ===Negotiations=== {{Quote|With all due respect, the ambassadors for the Supreme Chancellor wish to board immediately.''"''
''"''Yes, of course. As you know, our blockade is perfectly legal, and we'd be happy to receive the ambassadors.|Maoi Madakor and Nute Gunray||audio=MadakorAndGunray.flac}} During the [[blockade]] of Naboo, Gunray and another Trade Federation official, [[Rune Haako]] were onboard the ''Saak'ak'' when it was visited by [[Jedi Knight]]s [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who were [[ambassador]]s representing the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum|Valorum]]. Their ship, the ''[[Radiant VII]]'' docked in one of the ''Saak'ak''{{'s}} hangars and the Jedi were led to a conference room. Gunray was informed that the ambassadors were Jedi and contacted their superior, the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]], who ordered that the Jedi be killed. Gunray obliged by using the ''Saak'ak''{{'s}} hangar guns to destroy the ''Radiant VII'' and flooded the conference room with [[poison]] [[Dioxis|gas]], along with sending a squad of [[OOM-series security droid|security battle droids]] to make sure the Jedi were dead. [[File:QuiGonAndObiWanInTradeFederationShip-TPM.png|thumb|left|Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi fight battle droids in the ''Saak'ak''{{'s}} hallways.]] The Jedi emerged from the conference room unscathed, however, and quickly cut down the security droids, before making their way to the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. Gunray ordered that the bridge be sealed off and demanded [[droideka]]s be dispatched. He and Haako cowered in fear as the Jedi destroyed numerous battle droids and Jinn began trying to cut a hole in the bridge's doors with his [[lightsaber]]. Gunray ordered the blast doors to be closed, which only briefly set back Jinn, as he plunged his lightsaber back into the door, causing it to heat up and begin to fall apart. Before he could fully destroy the door, however, the droidekas arrived and kept the Jedi at bay, who decided to retreat, causing the droidekas to accidentally blow open the blast doors in the process. The Jedi [[Escape from the Saak'ak|went into a ventilation shaft]] and made their way to another hangar, where they saw [[B1-series battle droid|battle droids]] being loaded onto [[Multi-Troop Transport]]s and realized that the Trade Federation was planning to fully [[Invasion of Naboo|invade Naboo]]. The two stowed away on separate transports in order to flee to the surface and rescue Naboo's [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Amidala]]. The ''Saak'ak'' eventually launched its ships and began invading the planet. ===Holding up the blockade=== As the Trade Federation was capturing Naboo's capital city, [[Theed]], the Jedi were able to free Queen Amidala, her [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaidens]], and [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Head of Security|Head]], [[Quarsh Panaka]]. They boarded the Queen's [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship|starship]] and attempted to flee the planet. As they flew towards the blockade, the ''Saak'ak'' began firing at them, and managed to disable the ship's shield generator. They were able to repair the shield generator, however, and directly flew past the ''Saak'ak'' while they made their escape. ===Switching command=== Some time after Theed was captured, the ''Saak'ak'' and the rest of the Federation fleet left the [[Naboo system]], with the ship's command and crew transferred to the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]], the ''[[Vuutun Palaa]]''. ==Appearances== *''[[Queen's Peril]]'' {{Ab|Queen's Peril (audiobook)}} {{Hologram}} *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Phantom Menace'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *''[[Star Wars Journeys: The Phantom Menace]]'' {{1stID|''Saak'ak''}} *''[[Star Wars Journeys: Beginnings]]'' *{{StoryCite|story=Short Negotiations (The Prequel Trilogy Stories)|book=The Prequel Trilogy Stories|audiobook=1}} *{{GOA|Obi-Wan Kenobi (episode)}} {{Flash}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *{{DroidTales|Exit from Endor}} {{Flash}} *{{FreemakerAdventures|Zander's Joyride}} {{Flash}} *''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' *{{RebuildTheGalaxy|Part One}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|3|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|22|Databank A-Z}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A -
